performance.verdict: Meta efficient at $15.84 CPL; Google burning $675 with zero returns.

findings.text: Google Ads spent $675.54 over 28 days with 0 conversions — $0 return on every dollar. Confirmed dead channel for leads.
CPL rose 5.17% week-over-week to approximately $16.71 this week vs $15.84 baseline — spend up 8.68% but leads only up 3.33%.
SOW milestone: Stripe Products QA flagged Done on 2026-07-20 but no verified completed event confirmed in CRM data.
3-day lead signal (Aug 24–26): 0+3+8+4 = 15 leads vs prior 3 days (Aug 21–23): 8+8+0 = 16 leads — flat trend inside a volatile daily pattern with zero-spend gaps (Aug 23–24) distorting the window.
GHL shows 126 opportunities created vs 144 contacts and 0 won — 18-contact gap and 0 appointments suggest intake or follow-up pipeline leak, not an ads problem.

suggestions.text: Pause Google Ads entirely — $675.54 spent over 28 days with 0 conversions across 128 clicks is confirmed waste.
suggestions.monday_update: Pause all active Google Ads campaigns immediately. Google Ads has consumed $675.54 over the last 28 days and delivered zero conversions across 128 clicks — a confirmed zero-return channel. Success is confirmed when weekly Google spend reads $0 and those dollars stop bleeding. Re-evaluate Google only if pixel/conversion tracking is confirmed repaired by Sohib's team.

suggestions.text: Shift ~$15/day from Google Ads savings into Meta to hold lead volume without exceeding current total daily spend of ~$80.
suggestions.monday_update: Redirect approximately $15/day (a portion of the paused Google spend) into Meta campaigns to protect lead volume after the Google pause. Current Meta CPL is $15.84; this shift should add roughly 1 incremental lead per day at baseline efficiency. Confirm CPL stays at or below $17 after 7 days (by 2026-09-03). Do not exceed current total daily spend of ~$80.

suggestions.text: Investigate GHL intake: 18 contacts missing opportunities and 0 appointments in 28 days signals a pipeline intake leak.
suggestions.monday_update: Audit the 18 GHL contacts that have no corresponding opportunity created (162 contacts vs 126 opportunities). Check whether the WordPress/Stripe webhook or GHL Products payment path is dropping records. Success is confirmed when opportunity creation rate reaches 100% of incoming contacts and at least 1 appointment is booked within the next 7 days. Complete audit by 2026-09-03.
